reviews.comment: I liked him, PLEASE do not put it off after 327. I didn't learn the first half and that was my fault. Isn't as hard obvsiouly but still put some work into it. NO pop quizzes, the quizzes just got me because I got a lot wrong. Do it ahead of time! He is really funny, I liked him a lot, went to office hours a few times to clarify and was helpful!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Sweet professor and the class isn't too hard. Sometimes the lectures can drag a little, but just going back over the notes and exercises before tests made it pretty easy.

Prof Wang is such a nice guy. He is a great person and extremely wholesome. At least once per class, he would put a smile on my face. I would maybe agree that he could teach better, but overall the class isn't very difficult so it isn't a deal breaker. He wants you to succeed and its very clear.

This class is a lot less challenging than 327, and Professor Wang does a great job of teaching it. I recommend going over past exercises and quizzes before exams and you'll end up doing fine! The quizzes are really the hardest part of the class(a little under 10% of your grade) because it forces you to stay on top of the material. Hoping for an A.

He is a nice guy...but he sucks as a prof. There was a moment in class where he told us he didn't know how to teach a certain topic and to just read the textbook instead. He never really went over the material besides quickly reading over slides, and then we would spend half class talking about the stock market and things that aren't on our exams.

Professor Wang is such a caring professor. If you enjoyed 327 even though it was hard, you'll enjoy 328 and you'll do fine in the class. His exams are straightforward and he doesn't try to trick you(like 327 does). He has 6 quizzes that are hard to do well on if you're not on top of studying, so be sure to keep up. Loved this class.

Great 328 prof, he really tries his best to make the class easier. The exams are only multiple choice, but very straightforward questions straight from the lecture slides. He also gives really good curves on every exam! The final is optional. Very caring professor, would definitely recommend him for 328

Prof. Wang is such a great prof. and a cool guy so the 8am wasn't the worst thing in the world. Definitely possible to get an A in this class w/ the curves he gives. I just bombed one of the exams lol. The final is optional and will replace your lowest exam grade w/o hurting your final grade. Quizzes are open note w/ 2 devices allowed on lockdown.

Definitely take this prof if you get the chance. His style of teaching is awesome and the quizzes/tests are open book. Most of the theory questions you're able to find the answers to inside the book itself and to be honest it's a great way to get students to read the textbooks. I never read any acct textbooks before this class haha..
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT
